Carrier checks, helpful news later this week
We write to travelers

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should review their travel arrangements before departure so each pet can move safely and calmly through Aurelia Skyways service. Our team aims to keep the process clear, kind, and steady from booking through arrival.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare crates, documents, and comfort items, and a welfare coordinator checks animal comfort needs with care. If a crate is lost or if a pet escapes in transit, please speak with our staff right away so the report can be handled in an orderly way. <<FACT F118>> The next steps will be explained by the desk in plain terms.

We also ask travelers to keep carriers secure, label belongings clearly, and follow the guidance given at check in and during transit. <<FACT F114>> Small steps before travel can reduce stress for both traveler and animal, and our staff will work with you to support a safe journey.

Please bring all companion animal concerns to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for direct help.
